ops.title: The 2026-07-14 FP EDEADLK/frozen-replica incident fix train — fusekit v1.1.0 + cc-pool v0.55.0 SHIPPED; rollout + validation pending on both Macs
ops.body:
The 2026-07-14 EDEADLK incident (fileproviderd sandbox-extension exhaustion from cc-pool's own 10s deep-probe hammer + silent fleet-wide settings-replica freeze under FP's lazy content policy) is FIXED and SHIPPED: fusekit **v1.1.0** (shallow probe-domain + prepare-domain wire, fingerprint-gated signals, un-swallowed ErrAppUnavailable) and cc-pool **v0.55.0** (10s-shallow/5m-deep cadence with split strike ledgers, daemon-side manifest versions, memoized FP provider, launch gating select→validate→prepare→lease→execguard→banner→exec, pure-Go iopolicy exec guard [IOPOL_CMD_SET=2, GET resolves DEFAULT/OFF both to 1], eager .downloadEagerlyAndKeepDownloaded on computed items, fail-closed enumeration, SelectedID/Dir byte-for-byte validator, stats-cache/policy-limits classified private). Stage-2 finder+refuter caught a would-be regression: fusekit signalIfChanged passed the domain BASENAME to Source.Manifest (absolute ConfigDir is the contract) — signals would have gone permanently dark after the first; fixed pre-tag. cc-notes: Stage-0 verdict 64f56e48, Stage-2 verdict 2212808.

**Pending (user-gated rollout):** `brew upgrade cc-pool && brew upgrade --cask cc-pool-status` on BOTH Macs; each cask upgrade re-prompts group-container consent (cdhash-keyed, silent — needs one manual GUI approval per Mac); daemon reaps the stale appex. Validation: idle CCPoolFileProvider launches ≈0, base settings.json edit converges within one poll (~3.5m), fresh `ccp run` on an FP account with no Settings Error. yasyf-home: acct-12..16 still symlink-parked from the 07-14 bridge outage ([[yasyf-home-fp-bridge-outage-retreat]]) — re-migrate to FP only AFTER v0.55.0 proves out there.

**Deferred follow-ups:** W-X1 prepare-domain accepts a stale-but-materialized replica (needs app→bridge byte-compare; revisit if stale-launch reports persist); VM test with a genuinely dataless computed item (needs the signed cask in a VM); widget tests still not wired into ci.yml (release-gated only via this train's manual runs).
